title: Karumi vs LiveDemo: agentic demos compared
summary: "Karumi runs a live demo in your real product by voice or chat. LiveDemo's agent opens captured interactive demos. Features, pricing and fit, November 2026."
body_markdown:
Karumi and LiveDemo both sell an agentic demo, but the agent shows different things. Karumi's agent drives your real, live product in front of the buyer, while LiveDemo's AI Demo Agent answers from your docs and opens a captured interactive demo next to the chat.


Karumi is an AI demo agent: an autonomous agent that shows a buyer your real product live, by voice or chat, and answers questions as it goes. LiveDemo is a source-available interactive demo platform that added an AI Demo Agent on its Growth plan. This post compares the two side by side, with sources checked November 2026.


## What is the short answer?


Pick LiveDemo if you want low-cost, self-serve interactive demos with an AI layer on top, and you are happy for buyers to see captured screens. Pick Karumi if you want the agent to show the real product, do anything a buyer asks inside it, and join a live sales call.


Karumi LiveDemo


What the buyer sees Your real, live product, driven by the agent Captured interactive demos (HTML, screenshot or video) opened by the agent


How the agent talks Voice and chat Chat and voice, optional live video avatar


Where it runs Demo link, website widget, chat bar, inline start screen Website widget (bubble, pill, smart search bar), agent page link


Live sales calls Joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams Not described in its docs


Buyer's language Set per demo link Not stated on the pages we checked


Qualification and booking Yes, books the meeting on the right rep's calendar Yes, rule-based qualification, Calendly and Cal.com in the demo pane


CRM HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio HubSpot, Slack, webhooks


Security SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR (Enterprise) Not stated on the pages we checked


Self-hosting On-premise deployment (Enterprise) Source-available (FSL-1.1-MIT), free to self-host


Pricing Custom, scoped on a call Free plan; AI agent on Growth at $49 per creator per month


Sources:[Karumi pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) ,[LiveDemo pricing](https://livedemo.ai/pricing/) and[LiveDemo AI Demo Agent docs](https://livedemo.ai/docs/ai-demo-agent/create-an-ai-demo-agent/) , checked November 2026.


## How does a LiveDemo agentic demo work?


LiveDemo describes its agentic demo in three stages: qualify, guide and convert ([LiveDemo, "What is an agentic demo?"](https://livedemo.ai/blog/agentic-demo/) , checked November 2026).


- **Qualify.** The agent reads the page, referrer and UTM campaign. It then asks your qualification questions, one per reply. A fixed rule, not the AI, decides who is qualified.
- **Guide.** The agent answers only from the knowledge you give it: your website, docs, PDFs, FAQs and sales call transcripts. When a question is easier to show, it opens the matching interactive demo next to the conversation. The buyer clicks through that demo at their own pace.
- **Convert.** On a pricing or sales question, the agent offers a booking link. Calendly and Cal.com open inside the demo pane. After the session, your team gets a summary with intent, questions and the demos watched.


The core of the system is the interactive demo library. In LiveDemo's own words, "the agent's main tool is your interactive demos: it opens the one that answers the question." LiveDemo captures those demos as HTML, screenshots or video, from a Chrome extension, a Figma plugin and desktop apps ([LiveDemo, interactive demo software](https://livedemo.ai/interactive-demo-software/) , checked November 2026).


LiveDemo does several things well. Its pricing is public and low. It has a free plan. Its Knowledge Gaps report groups the questions the agent could not answer. It re-crawls your website every 24 hours by default. And it is the only tool in its own comparison that you can self-host for free.


## How does a Karumi demo work?


Karumi's agent does not open a captured copy. It opens your real product and decides, as the conversation goes, what to show and where to click. It is not a recording, a replica or a guided tour. You can read more in[how Karumi works](https://karumi.ai/blog/how-does-karumi-work) and[is a Karumi demo live or a recording?](https://karumi.ai/blog/is-karumi-demo-live-or-recording) .


What that means for a buyer:


1. The buyer starts a demo from a link, a website widget, a chat bar or an inline start screen.
2. The agent talks with them by voice or chat, in their language.
3. When they ask "can it do X?", the agent goes to X in the real product and shows it.
4. When they are ready, the agent books the meeting on the right rep's calendar.
5. The session, with analytics and conversion events, syncs to HubSpot, Salesforce or Attio.


Karumi also joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls ([can Karumi join Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls?](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls) ). A rep can bring the agent into a live call. And a live demo can go into a cold email or sequence, pre-filled for each contact.


## What is the real difference between the two?


The difference is what the agent can show when a buyer goes off the path.


A LiveDemo agent can only open demos that someone captured beforehand. If a buyer asks about a screen nobody captured, the agent can answer in words from your docs, but it has nothing to show. LiveDemo says this openly: "The agent can only show and explain what you've given it."


A Karumi agent works in the real product, so the screen the buyer asks about is there. In our experience, buyers ask about the setting, report or integration that matters to their own team, not the happy path. That is where showing beats telling.


The trade-off is setup and cost. A captured demo is quick to make and cheap to host. A live product demo needs a demo environment and a login for the agent, and Karumi scopes each plan with you. For a deeper look at the two formats, read[agentic demos vs interactive demos](https://karumi.ai/blog/agentic-demos-vs.-interactive-demos) .


## How much do Karumi and LiveDemo cost?


LiveDemo publishes its prices. As of November 2026 ([LiveDemo pricing](https://livedemo.ai/pricing/) ):


- **Startup:** free for 1 creator, 3 published demos, with a watermark.
- **Pro:** $34 per creator per month, or $27 billed yearly. Unlimited demos, no AI agent.
- **Growth:** $49 per creator per month, or $39 billed yearly. Adds the AI Demo Agent, voice, live video avatars (1,000 avatar credits a month, about 60 minutes, one live session at a time), the website widget, qualification, booking and HubSpot, Slack and webhook integrations.
- **Business:** custom, from 10 creators. Adds whitelabel, a custom domain and dedicated support.


LiveDemo bills per creator, not per visitor. Visitors and demo viewers do not count.


Karumi does not publish a list price. As of November 2026,[Karumi pricing](https://karumi.ai/pricing) has two plans:


- **Growth:** custom agents, languages and sessions, agent builder access, session insights, data export to CRM and an MCP connection.
- **Enterprise:** everything in Growth, plus on-premise deployment, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and GDPR, enterprise SLAs, dedicated server capacity and a dedicated success team.


Karumi's pricing page says the price depends on the number of agents, demo volume, languages and integrations. Most teams start with a pilot on one use case.


## Who should choose LiveDemo?


LiveDemo is a strong fit when:


- You are a startup or a small product marketing team and want to start free.
- Your buyers mostly self-serve on your website and a clickable tour answers most of their questions.
- You already have, or want to build, a library of interactive demos.
- Budget matters more than depth, and per-creator pricing suits your team size.
- You want to self-host the code or need a whitelabel option.


## Who should choose Karumi?


Karumi is a strong fit when:


- Buyers ask questions that a fixed set of captured screens cannot answer.
- You want the agent to show the real product, so the demo matches what the buyer will use.
- You sell across languages and want each buyer to get the demo in theirs.
- You want the same agent on your website, in outbound emails and inside live Google Meet, Zoom or Teams calls.
- You use Salesforce or Attio as well as HubSpot.
- Your security team needs SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and an on-premise option.


To see the other tools in this category, read[what is an AI demo agent?](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-is-an-ai-demo-agent) and[the best interactive demo software](https://karumi.ai/blog/best-interactive-demo-software) .


## FAQ


### Is LiveDemo an AI demo agent?


Yes, on its Growth plan. LiveDemo's AI Demo Agent answers from your website, docs and sales calls, opens the matching captured interactive demo, qualifies visitors and books meetings. Its base product is an interactive demo builder.


### Does Karumi use captured demos like LiveDemo?


No. Karumi's agent shows your real, live product and decides what to show as the conversation goes. It is not a recording, a replica or a clickable tour.


### Which is cheaper, Karumi or LiveDemo?


LiveDemo is cheaper to start. As of November 2026, it has a free plan and its AI agent costs $49 per creator per month on Growth. Karumi prices each plan with you on a call, based on agents, demo volume, languages and integrations.


### Can LiveDemo or Karumi join a sales call?


Karumi joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls. LiveDemo's docs, checked November 2026, describe the agent on your website and on a shareable agent page, not inside video calls.


### Do both tools qualify leads and book meetings?


Yes. LiveDemo uses your qualification rules and opens Calendly or Cal.com in the demo pane. Karumi qualifies and scores leads during the demo, books the meeting on the right rep's calendar and writes the session to your CRM.


### Can I self-host either tool?


LiveDemo is source-available under the FSL-1.1-MIT license and free to self-host on every plan, without whitelabel. Karumi offers on-premise deployment on its Enterprise plan.


### Which tool should a small team pick?


If one marketer needs a clickable tour on the homepage this week, LiveDemo's free plan is a sensible start. If your buyers need to see the real product and get answers to their own questions, Karumi is the better fit.
